Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Crusade: Columbia, SC will be fought on Saturday, October 30, 1999
at Heroes and Dragons (http://www.heroesanddragons.com).

Registration is a 11:00 (frequent participants: note the later time)

DCI Sanctioned, Contructed Deck event. Three rounds plus a final.
No entry fee. Prizes supplied by WotC and Heroes and Dragons.

** Update **
Prizes will also include a Protected Resources for 1st place,
supplied by the Prince of Columbia, Joe Churchill.
************

H&D is in a shopping center at the corner of Bush River and Broad
River Roads near the intersection of I-20 and I-26. E-mail me
for directions or more information.
